title: Shared equipment turnaround
frame: A municipal maintenance depot lends specialist equipment to four crews. During the last six weeks, 19 of 74 bookings started late although the booking calendar showed the equipment available. Return times, cleaning completion and collection times are recorded in separate logs; some entries are missing. The depot manager has two weeks to choose changes that reduce late starts without buying equipment or adding staff. Work out what to investigate and how to decide which change to trial.
